conflicts.description: Product information sync with SAP is specified as both real-time and daily batch process

version_a.text: Inventory levels must sync with SAP ERP in real time.

version_b.text: Product information must sync from SAP via daily batch process.

conflicts.description: TR-027 and US-015 both mandate real-time inventory sync with SAP, but TR-028 mandates daily batch sync for product information — if inventory is part of product information, these directly conflict on sync frequency

version_a.text: Inventory levels must sync with SAP ERP in real time.

version_b.text: Product information must sync from SAP via daily batch process.

conflicts.description: Vendors are stated to manage their own product listings and product information, but a separate business rule explicitly prohibits vendors from setting or modifying prices — US-016 grants vendors ability to manage listings which typically includes pricing

version_a.text: The system shall allow vendors to create, update, and manage their product listings.

version_b.text: Vendors cannot set or modify product prices; only central admin controls pricing.

conflicts.description: Vendor portal allows managing product information including listings, but pricing control is exclusively reserved for central admin, creating an ambiguous boundary in vendor product management scope

version_a.text: Vendors must be able to manage their product information and inventory via portal.

version_b.text: Vendors cannot set or modify product prices; only central admin controls pricing.

conflicts.description: GDPR compliance requires data handling rules that may conflict with the absolute requirement to store all customer data on servers physically located within India, as GDPR is an EU regulation with its own data residency and transfer rules that may not align with India-only storage for NRI customers

version_a.text: Platform must comply with GDPR regulations for NRI customer data handling.

version_b.text: All customer data must be stored on servers physically located within India.

conflicts.description: ZestMoney partnership is listed only as an assumption to be finalized before go-live, yet no corresponding functional requirement exists for ZestMoney integration — however TR-018 assumption conflicts with TR-009 constraint if the partnership is not finalized within the 6-month go-live window

version_a.text: Platform must go live within 6 months maximum from project start.

version_b.text: ZestMoney partnership agreement will be finalized before platform go-live.

conflicts.description: Central admin is described as controlling pricing across the platform, but US-014 also grants central admin the ability to set prices — this is consistent internally, but TR-007 and TR-021 together conflict with TR-008 and US-016 which imply vendors manage their own listings autonomously including product details that could encompass pricing

version_a.text: Central admin team manages products, pricing, and promotions across the platform.

version_b.text: Vendor partners manage their own inventory and product listings via dedicated login.
